messages:
Alex Kim: Quick heads-up — I want to run a dry-run for the annotated tag + GitHub draft release tomorrow at 10:00am PT. Will test artifacts and draft body.
Maria Chen: +1. I can prep the changelog bullets tonight. Do you want high-level bullets or link-per-PR? :spiral_note_pad:
Alex Kim: High-level bullets please, and include any PRs that fixed regressions. We can paste the full list into the draft release body.
Jamal Ortiz: For the dry-run can we also validate release asset checksums and the signed tags? I can run the checksum and signature verification steps.
Alex Kim: Yes — please validate signature flow. I’ll simulate the exact commands we use in prod tagging.
Sophie Lee: Reminder: bump package versions before creating annotated tags. Use patch unless there are breaking changes. I'll add a note to the release checklist.
Maria Chen: Got it. I'll add a short changelog snippet for the top-line fixes and one-liners for improvements.
Alex Kim: I'll create a staging branch `release-dryrun/annotated-test` and push a test annotated tag `v1.9.3-dryrun` so CI runs and artifacts upload to GH actions artifacts.
Jamal Ortiz: Can you include the exact git commands you’ll run? I'll mirror them on my side.
Alex Kim: Sure — running this locally in staging:

```
git checkout -b release-dryrun/annotated-test
git commit --allow-empty -m "dryrun: prepare release"
git tag -a v1.9.3-dryrun -m "dry-run annotated tag for release automation"
git push origin release-dryrun/annotated-test
git push origin v1.9.3-dryrun
```

Then GH Actions should build and upload `redwood-inference-artifacts-v1.9.3-dryrun.tar.gz` to the draft release.
deploy-bot: Note: Draft releases created by the automation are prefixed with `[dryrun]` in the title. CI policy: all checks must pass before auto-populating release notes.
Sophie Lee: Also check that CHANGELOG.md generation runs in the workflow (we had an issue last time where the script skipped on non-master branches).
Maria Chen: I'll run the changelog script locally: `scripts/generate_changelog --since v1.9.2` and paste the output into the draft.
Jamal Ortiz: After artifacts are uploaded I'll run `sha256sum` on the tarball, sign with our release key, and attach `.sig` to the draft release for verification.
Alex Kim: Great — let's meet async here. If all looks good by 11:30am PT I'll flip the dry-run into a checklist for the real tag procedure later this week. Ping me if anything blocks.
Maria Chen: Thanks — I'll post the changelog snippet in this thread once ready. :+1:
Sophie Lee: Ping me if you need a quick version bump PR review.
Alex Kim: Thanks team — appreciate it.
